label: Deuterium (D2) UV lamp

diameter.help: emit face diameter (circular) or edge length (rectangular, round_flag=0)

tooltip: Deuterium arc lamp: the UV continuum only (spectrum=d2_uv_approx, ~185-400nm smooth hump peaking ~230-250nm) -- the real D2 Balmer-alpha/beta atomic lines at 486/656nm are DELIBERATELY OMITTED from this continuum-only table (see the emitters.miesrc row notes); do not use this preset where the visible Balmer lines matter. lambdac=250nm is a representative UV wavelength; the spectrum table supersedes it for actual wavelength sampling.
